d2Metrics.title: Growth
d2Metrics.intro: Daily totals from the platform's own records and first-party button counts. No visitor ids, no cookies, no third parties.
d2Metrics.window: UTC days {from} to {to}. Today's totals are counted after midnight UTC.
d2Metrics.floorNote: Any count under {floor} is hidden, so no small group can be picked out.
d2Metrics.empty.title: No growth numbers yet
d2Metrics.empty.body: The nightly job fills this in after the first full UTC day. Button counts appear as people use the site.
d2Metrics.funnel.viewerIntro: From a new account to co-op membership. Each step is shown against new accounts.
d2Metrics.funnel.creatorIntro: Channels that went live for the first time, and those that came back within 14 days.
d2Metrics.metrics.title: Every metric
d2Metrics.hint.accountsCreated: Accounts made by people (bots not counted).
d2Metrics.hint.accountsVerified: New accounts whose email is now verified.
d2Metrics.hint.firstFollow: A first follow within 7 days of making the account.
d2Metrics.hint.firstChat: A first chat message within 7 days of making the account.
d2Metrics.hint.firstSupport: A first sub or tip within 30 days of making the account.
d2Metrics.hint.becameMember: People who joined the co-op for the first time.
d2Metrics.hint.notifyOptin: People who turned on email or push alerts.
d2Metrics.hint.firstLive: Channels that went live for the first time.
d2Metrics.hint.secondLive: Channels that streamed again within 14 days of their first stream.
d2Metrics.hint.activeStreamers: Channels live at least once in the 30 days up to the last day.
d2Metrics.hint.membersTotal: Co-op members on the last day.
d2Metrics.intents.title: New accounts by why they signed up
d2Metrics.ui.title: Button views and clicks
d2Metrics.ui.empty: No button counts in this period.
d2Metrics.numbers.title: Accounts, members and streamers
d2Metrics.numbers.intro: New accounts, co-op members and active streamers for each of the last 12 months (UTC), from our own records.
d2Metrics.numbers.membersHint: members at the end of the month
d2Metrics.numbers.streamersHint: channels live in the 30 days to the month's end
d2Metrics.numbers.tableCaption: Accounts, members and streamers by month
d2Metrics.numbers.floorNote: Counts under {floor} show as "fewer than {floor}", so no one can be picked out. The current month is counted so far.
